m: देवका f. fam. for देव-दत्तिका, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 45, Vārtt. 4, Pat.
देव—काञ्चन m. ‘divine gold’, the tree Bauhinea Purpurea, L.
देव—काम (˚व-क्˚), mfn. loving the gods, pious, RV.
देव—कान्त m. ‘god-loved’ (?), magnet, L. (cf. चन्द्र-, सूर्य-).

v: na॰ devapriyArTaM kAryam । 1 devapriyArTe homapUjAdO kArye “devakAryAt dvijAtInAM pitfkAryaM viSezyate” manuH । devAnAmamilazitaM kAryam । 2 devABilazite kArye ca “anuzWitadevakAryam” raGuH kftarAvaRabaDAdirUpadevakAryamityarTaH । devakarmAdayo'pyatra “devakarmakftaScEva yuktAH kAmena karmasu” BA॰ SA॰ 167 a॰
m: देव—कार्य n. = -कर्मन्, Mn.; MBh.
any matter concerning the gods, divine command, Ragh. xii, 103.

s: strI, (devakasya AtmajA kanyA .) devakI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: strI 6 ta॰ । devakanfpasutAyAM devakyAM prADAnyAt SabdaratnA॰ ।
m: देवकात्मजा f. id., L.

s: klI, (devapriyaM kAzWam .) devadAru । iti ratnamAlA ॥ devadArupraBedaH । tatparyyAyaH । pUtikAzWam 2 BadrakAzWam 3 sukAzWakam 4 snigDadArukam 5 kAzWadAru 6 । asya guRAH । tiktatvam । uzRatvam । rUkzatvam । SlezmAnilApahatvaYca । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ devapriyaM kAzWamasya । devadAruvfkze ratnA॰ । “manaHSilA devakAzWaM rajanyO triPalozaRam” suSru॰ ।
m: देव—काष्ठ n. ‘divine wood’, Pinus Devadāru or some other kind of pine, Suśr.

s: strI, (devaka + NIz .) devakarAjakanyA । sA vasudevapatnI SrIkfzRamAtA । tatparyyAyaH । dEvakI 2 kfzRajananI 3 devakAtmajA 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ iyaM kaSyapapatnI adityaMSajAtA । yaTA, -- “devakI rohiRI ceme vasudevasya DImataH । rohiRI suraBirdevI aditirdevakI hyaBUt ॥” api ca । “kaSyapo vasudevaSca devamAtA ca devakI । pUrvvapuRyaPalenEva saMprApa SrIhariM sutam ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqam ॥
v: strI devaka + puMyoge NIz puMyogaSca na kevala dAmpatyalakzaRaH kintu janyajanakatvAdirUpo'pIti haradattaH tena kekayIti sidDam । devakarAjakanyABede devakaSabde dfSyam । devakI ca kaSyapapatnyA aditeravatAraH yaToktaM harivaM॰ 56 a॰ “tasya (kaSyapasya) BAryAdvayaYcEva aditiH suraBistaTA । devakI rohiRI cEva vasudevasya DImataH”
m: देवकी f. See below.
देवकी f. N. of a daughter of Devaka (see above) who was wife of Vasu-deva and mother of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. (identified with अ-दिति, Hariv.; with दाक्षायणी, MatsyaP.)
a: देवकी — N. of a daughter of Devaka and wife of Vasudeva and mother of Kṛṣṇa. --Comp. --नंदनः, --पुत्रः, --मातृ m. --सूनुः, epithets of Kṛṣṇa.

v: pu॰ devakI mAtA yasya samAsAntaviDeranityatvAt na kap, devakIM minoti prasUtitvena mA--tfc vA । vAsu deve SrIkfzRe । “paSyEtAn devakImAtarmumUrzUnadya saMyuge” BA॰ dro॰ 18 a॰ praTame vigrahe sarvanAmasTAne pare guRaH devakImAtaramityAdi dvitIye devakImAtAramiti BedaH ।
m: देवकी—मातृ m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, ChUp.; MBh.; Hariv.

s: puM, (devakyA nandanaH .) SrIkfzRaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 1 । 8 । 21 । “kfzRAya vAsudevAya devakInandanAya ca । nandagopakumArAya govindAya namo namaH ॥” kvacidIkArasya hrasvo'pi dfSyate । yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 24 । 31 । “nEtaccitraM mahAbAho ! tvayi devakinandane ॥”)
v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । vasudevapatnyA devakyAnandane SrIkfzRe । “nandagopasya jAyEkA vasudevasya cAparA । tulyakAlaM hi garBiRyO yaSodA devakI taTA । devakyajanayadvizRuM yaSodA tAntu kanyakAm । muhUrtte'Bijite prApte sArdDarAtre viBUzite” harivaM॰ । 60 a॰ “devakInandanaH srazwA kzitISaH pApanASanaH” vizRusaM॰ “gfhItvA haraRaM prApte kfzRe devakinandane” BA॰ A॰ 1 a॰ saMjYAtvAt NIzo hrasvaH
m: देवकी—नन्दन (or ˚कि-न्˚) m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, ChUp.; MBh.; Hariv.

k.v: देवकीनन्दनः शौरिः श्रीपतिः पुरुषोत्तमः। वनमाली बलिध्वंसी कंसारातिरधोक्षजः॥

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 SrIkfzRe “balavAnnEva dAsyAmi devakIputramASritaH” harivaM॰ 142 a॰ । 2 puruzayajYadarSanavidyAyAM GoranAmakANgirasasya SizyaBUte kfzRe ca । yajYadarSanamupakragya “tadDEtadGIra ANgirasaH kfzRAya devakIputrAyoktovAcA'pipAsa eva sa baBUva so'ntavelAya metattrayaM pratipadyetAkzitamasyacyutamasi prARaSaMsitamasIti” CA॰ u॰ 3 । 17 । 6 “tadDEtat yajYadarSanaM GoronAmataH, ANgiraso gotrataH kfzRAya devakIputrAya SizyAyoktvovAca tadetattrayamityAdi vyavahitena sambanDaH । sa cEtaddarSanaM SrutvA'pipAsa evAnyAByo vidyAByo baBUva । itTaYca viSizweyaM vidyA yat kfzRasya devakIputrasyAnyAM vidyAM prati tfqvicCedakarIti puruzayajYavidyAM stOti Gora aNgirasaH kfzRAyoktvemAM vidyAM kimuvAceti tadAha sa evaM yaToktayajYavidantavelAyAM maraRakAla etanmantratrayaM pratipadyeta japedityarTaH । kiM tat akzitamakzIRamakzataM vA'sItyekaM yajuH” BA॰ atra parameSvarasya vAsudevAtmakeSvarasya anyaSizyatvAnupapattO iha tadanyasyEva Sizyatvam । SrutO sfzweH anAdipravAharUpatayA vAsudevasya SizyatvakalpanayA janakayAjYavalkayoriva kalpAntarasTayoriyamAKyAyikA stutyarTetyanye । devakIsutAdayo'pi vAsudeve । “aTa BAdrapade mAsi kfzRAzwamyAM kalO yuge । azwAviMSatime jAtaH kfzRo'sO devakIsutaH” ti॰ ta॰ brahmapu॰ “nyADAyizAtAmaBidevakIsutam” mAGaH ।
m: देवकी—पुत्र m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, ChUp.; MBh.; Hariv.
देव—कीर्ति m. N. of an astronomer, Cat.

s: puM, (devakyAH sUnuH puttraH .) SrIkfzRaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 132 ॥ (yaTA, Bavizye । “tuzwyarTaM devakIsUnorjayantI saMjYakaM vratam । karttavyaM cintyamAnena BaktyA BaktajanEH saha ॥”)
m: देवकी—सूनु m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, ChUp.; MBh.; Hariv.

v: tri॰ devasyedam gahA॰ Ca “devasya ca” pA॰ ga॰ tadanuSizwaH kuk ca । devasambanDini ।
m: देवकीय mfn. (g. गहादि) divine, belonging or relating to a divinity, W.

v: na॰ vaSizWASramasannikfzwasTe tIrTaBede “tatrASramo va SizWasya trizu lokezu viSrutaH । tatrABizekaM kurvARo vAjapeyamavApnuyAt । devakUwaM samAsAdya devarzigaRasevitam” BA॰ va॰ 84 a॰ ।
m: देव—कूट n. ‘d˚ peak’, N. of a mountain, VāyuP.

s: puM, yaduvaMSIyarAjaviSezaH । sa SrIkfzRasya mAtAmahaH । iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ (ayantu ganDarvvapateraMSAvatAraH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 67 । 69 । “yastvAsIddevako nAma devarAjasamadyutiH । sa ganDarvvapatirmuKyaH kzitO jajYe narADipaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ diva--Rvul । 1 krIqake 2 ganDarvapatiBede 3 SrIkfzRasya mAtAmahe Ahukaputre nfpaBede ca pu॰ “yastvAsIddevako nAma devarAjasamadyutiH । sa ganDarvapatirmuKyaH kzitO jajYe narADipaH” BA॰ A॰ 67 a॰ tasyEva devakanAmnA kalAvavatAraH ityarTaH । “Ahukasya tu kASyAyAM dvO putrO sambaBUvatuH । devakaScograsenaSca devagarBasamAvuBO । devakasyABavan putrAScatvArastridaSopamAH । devavAnupadevaSca sandevo devarakzitaH । kumAryaH sapta cAsyAsan vasudevAya tA dadO । devakI SAntidevA ca sandevA devarakzitA । vfkadevyupadevI ca sunAmnI cEva saptamI” harivaM॰ 38 a॰ । 4 tatkanyAyAM strI NIz । devakISabde dfSyam
m: देवक mf(इका)n. who or what sports or plays, W.
divine, celestial id.
देवक m. (दिव्˚) a god, deity (at the end of an adj. comp.), MBh. ii, 1396 &c. (cf. दैवक)
N. of a man (?), RV. vii, 18, 20; Sāy.
of a Gandharva (at once a prince, son of Āhuka and father of Devakī [below] MBh. i, 4480; v, 80 &c.; Hariv.; Pur.)
of a son of Yudhiṣṭhira and Yaudheyī or Pauravī (cf. ˚विका below), Pur.
familiar N. for देव-दत्तक, Pāṇ. v, 3, 83; Pat.
देवक m. pl. N. of the Śūdras in Krauñca-dvīpa, BhP. v, 20, 22
a: देवक — a. [दिव-ण्वुल्] 1 Sporting, playing. --2 Divine, godlike, celestial. --कः (at the end of comp.) A god, deity.

m: देवक—भोज-पुत्री f. patron. of Devakī, BhP. iii, 1, 33.

देव—कन्या f. id., MBh.; R.
देव—कन्यका f. a celestial maiden, a nymph, Kāv.
देव—कड m. (for कृत?) N. of a Grāma, MW. (cf. देवी-कृति).

v: pu॰ devapriyaH kardama iva । SrIKaRqAgurukarpUra kuNkumErmilitEH kfte kardamarUpe ganDadravyaBede rAjani॰ ।
m: देव—कर्दम m. ‘divine paste’, a fragrant p˚ of sandal, Agallochum, camphor, and safflower, L.

s: puM, (devapriyaH karddama iva .) suganDidravyaviSezaH । sa SrIKaRqAgurukarpUrakuNkumasaMmiSritErBavati । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: देव—कर्म m. master of divine or sacred work, RV. x, 130, 1.
देव—कर्˚म-कृत् mfn. performing it, MBh.

देव—कवच n. divine armour, MW. (cf. देवी-).

देव—कृत्य n. = -कार्य, MBh.; BhP.
देव—किल्बिष n. offence against the gods, RV. x, 97, 16.

s: strI, (devaM meGaM kiratIti । kF + “igupaDajYeti .” 3 । 1 । 135 । iti kaH । gOrAditvAt NIz .) meGarAgasya BAryyA । yaTA, -- “lalitA mAlasI gOrI nAwI devakirI taTA । meGarAgasya rAgiRyo BavantImAH sumaDyamAH ॥” asyAH svarUpaM yaTA, -- “BramantI nandane SyAmA puzpapracayatatparA । KyAtA devakirI hyezA karArpitasaKIkarA ॥” iti saNgItadAmodaraH ॥
v: strI meGarAgasya BAryyABede rAgiRIBede tadrAgasya rAgiRIBedAH tatsvarUpaYca saNgItadA॰ uktaM yaTA “lalitA mAlatI gOrI nAwI devakirI taTA । meGarAgasya rAgiRyo BavantImAH sumaDyamAH” । asyA svarUpaM yaTA “BramantI nandane SyAmA puzpapracayatatparA । KyAtA devakirI hyezA karArpitasaKIkarA” devagirIti vA pAWaH ।
m: देव—किरी f. (in music) N. of a Rāgiṇī regarded as wife of Megha-rāga (cf. -गिरी, देश-करी, गोण्ड-किरी, राम-क्˚).
देव—कोश m. d˚ cask or receptacle, AV.; TāṇḍyaBr.
देव—क्री f. (in music) N. of a Rāga (cf. -किरी).
देव—कुण्ड n. a natural spring, L., Sch.
देव—कु˚लावास m. pl. buildings belonging to a t˚, Kathās.

s: klI, (devAya kolatIti । kula saNGAte + kaH .) vinAmuKam । iti hArAvalI । 198 ॥ deula iti BAzA ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 12 । 127 । “so'haM dAridrasantaptastatra nArAyaRAgrataH । nirAhAraH sTito'kArzaM gatvA devakulaM tapaH ॥”) asya vivaraRaM cEtyaSabde drazwavyam ॥
v: na॰ kula--saMhatO ka devArTaM kulamalpadvAratayA saMhatam । alpamuKe (deula) KyAte devagfhaBede hArA॰ । devAnAM 2 vaMSe 3 samUhe ca
m: देव—कुल n. ‘deity-house’, a temple, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Kāv.; Var. &c.
देव—कु˚लिका f. a small t˚, chapel, Pañcad.
देव—कु˚लिक m. attendant on a t˚, L.

v: strI devakftA kulyA alpasarit । 1 devasariti gaNgAyAm 6 ta॰ । marIcaH kanyAyAH pUrRimAsaH 2 kanyAyAYca “patnI marIcestu kalA suzuve kardamAtmajA । kaSyapaM pUrRamAsaYca yayorApUritaM jagat । pUrRimAsUta virajaM viSvagaYca parantapa । devakulyAM hareH pAdaSOcAd yA'BUt sariddivaH” BAga॰ 4 । 1 । 12 । sA ca BaratavaMSyasya BUmnaH patnIBedaH yaTAha BAga॰ 5 । 15 । 6 “BaratasyAtmajaH sumatirnAma” ityupakrame “pratihartuH stutyAmajaBUmAnAvajanizAtAm । BUmna fzikulyAyAmudgITaH tataH prastArA devakulyAyAm” ।
m: देव—कुल्या f. ‘river of the gods’, personified as a daughter of Pūrṇiman and grand-daughter of Marīci, BhP.
N. of the wife of Ud-gītha, ib.
देव—कुरु m. N. of a people and country (associated with the उत्तर-क्˚), L., Sch.
देव—कुरुम्बा f. N. of a plant (= महाद्रोण), L.

s: klI, (devapriyaM kusumaM puzpaM yasya .) lavaNgam । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 125 ॥
m: देव—कुसुम n. ‘divine flower’, cloves, Bhpr.

k.v: लाक्षा राक्षा जतु क्लीबे यावोऽलक्तो द्रुमामयः। लवङ्गं देवकुसुमं श्रीसंज्ञमथ जायकम्.।

m: देव˚क्य mfn. id.
godlike, corresponding to the number of the gods (said of the metre Anuṣṭubh), ŚāṅkhBr. xxvii, 3 (v.l. ˚त्य).

v: pu॰ krozwuvaMSye nfpaBede “tasmAt karamBaH kAramBirdevarAto'BavannfpaH! । devakzatro'Bavattasya dEvakzatrirmahAyaSAH । devavargasamo jajYe devakzatrasya nandanaH” harivaM॰ 37 a॰ । devAnAM kzatraM balaM yatra । 2 yajYe ca “ucCantyAM me yajatA devakzatre ruSad gavi” f॰ 5 । 64 । 7 “devakzatre yajYe” BA॰ ।
m: देव—क्षत्र n. (˚व-क्˚), domain of the gods, RV. v, 64, 7 (-क्षेत्र?)
देव—क्षत्र m. N. of a prince (son of Deva-rāta), Hariv.; Pur.
देव—क्षेम m. N. of the author of the Vijñāna-kāya, Buddh.
देव—क्षेत्र n. domain of the g˚, Br.
